description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'sgd_modified_huber' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer + SGD classifier (modified Huber loss).
model: sgd_modified_huber (TF-IDF word featurizer + SGD classifier (modified Huber loss))
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'sgd_modified_huber', group(s): linear, online); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
